name: 1.7 Animations
text: Brings back the 1.7 swing, block and eat animations.

name: Ambience
text: Tints the sky and fog.

name: Armor Status
text: Shows your armour and held item with durability.

name: Armour Break Alert
text: Warns you when a piece of armour is about to break.

name: Attack Indicator
text: A clearer attack cooldown indicator, per weapon.

name: Auto GG
text: Says gg for you when a game ends. Knows the big servers, and you can add your own trigger words.

name: Auto Respawn
text: Respawns you after you die. Never in hardcore.

name: Behind You (hold V / B)
text: Hold V to look behind you, B for the front view.

name: Better Chat
text: Stacks repeated messages, keeps chat between worlds, slide-in and a nicer background.

name: Biome
text: Shows the biome you are standing in.

name: Block Outline
text: Changes the colour and thickness of the block outline.

name: Bobbing
text: Turns screen and hand bobbing on or off one by one.

name: Bow Charge
text: Shows how far your bow or crossbow is drawn.

name: Camera
text: Third person distance and FOV changes for sprint, flying and bows.

name: Chat Filter
text: Hides or highlights messages with the words you pick.

name: Chat History
text: Keeps your sent messages after you restart the game.

name: Chat Macros (F6-F9)
text: Send a message or command with F6 to F9.

name: Chat Timestamps
text: Adds the time to every chat message.

name: Chat Tools
text: Copy or delete messages, preview images and safer clickable commands.

name: China Hat
text: A see-through cone hat over your head.

name: Clear Weather
text: Hides rain and snow on your screen. The server still has weather.

name: Clock
text: Shows the real time on your computer.

name: Colour Blind Filter
text: Shifts colours so reds, greens or blues you can't tell apart stand out from each other.

name: Combo Counter
text: Counts hits in a row without getting hit back.

name: Compass
text: A compass strip at the top of the screen.

name: Confirm Disconnect
text: Asks before you leave a server.

name: Coordinates
text: Shows your X, Y and Z position and the way you are facing.

name: CPS
text: Shows how many times you click per second, left and right.

name: Crash Patch
text: If the game crashes in a world, it takes you to a menu instead of closing.

name: Crosshair
text: Your own crosshair: style, size, gap and colour.

name: Custom FOV
text: Sets your field of view past the vanilla limit.

name: Damage Tint by Type
text: Tints the hurt flash by what hurt you: fire, fall, poison and so on.

name: Day Counter
text: Shows which in-game day the world is on.

name: Death Coordinates
text: Posts where you died in chat so you can find your things.

name: Detailed Armour Bar
text: A clearer armour bar, with the exact number if you want it.

name: Durability Alert
text: Warns you when your held tool or weapon is low on durability.

name: Easy Place
text: Place blocks on doors, trapdoors, chests and other usable blocks without sneaking.

name: Effect Bars
text: Draws a draining bar under each vanilla effect icon.

name: Effect Timers
text: Puts the time left on the vanilla effect icons.

name: Elytra HUD
text: While gliding: speed, pitch, elytra durability and how many rockets you have.

name: Food & Saturation
text: Shows your hunger and hidden saturation.

name: FPS
text: Shows your frames per second.

name: Frame Report
text: Tells the launcher your FPS and 1% lows, so it can warn you when a mod update makes the game slower.

name: Free Slots
text: Shows how many inventory slots are empty, or only warns when you run low.

name: Freecam
text: Fly the camera away from your player, great for screenshots. Off on servers unless you allow it.

name: Freelook (hold Alt)
text: Hold Alt to look around without turning your player.

name: Gamma per Dimension
text: A brightness level for each dimension.

name: Ghost Race
text: Press K to start a run after a 3 second count, K again to stop. Start at the same spot to race your best run as a ghost, or load a friend's ghost by code from Ghosts in the pause menu.

name: Glint Colour
text: Changes the colour of the enchantment glint.

name: Hand Position
text: Moves and resizes your hand in first person.

name: Hand Sway
text: Changes how much your hand sways when you turn.

name: Health
text: Shows your exact health, with absorption if you want it.

name: Held Item Count
text: Counts how many of the item in your hand you have in total, handy for blocks.

name: Hide Scoreboard
text: Hides the sidebar scoreboard.

name: Hit Bubbles
text: Pops coloured bubbles where your hit lands.

name: Hit Colour
text: Changes the red flash on mobs and players you hit.

name: Hit Particle Colour
text: Recolours crit and sharpness particles.

name: Hit Particles
text: Adds more particles when you hit.

name: Hit Sound
text: Plays a sound when you hit someone.

name: Hitboxes
text: Shows entity hitboxes, by type of entity.

name: Inventory
text: Inventory tweaks: blur behind it, click outside to close, keep the cursor.

name: Inventory Scale
text: A separate GUI scale for chests and other containers.

name: IRL Weather
text: Matches the in-game weather to the weather where you live.

name: Item Counter
text: Counts items in your inventory, like pearls, gapples or arrows.

name: Item Tooltips
text: Adds durability as a number to tooltips and shows what is inside shulker boxes and on maps.

name: Jump Circles
text: Draws a ring on the ground when you jump.

name: Keystrokes
text: Shows WASD, jump and mouse buttons as you press them.

name: Kromvia Font
text: Draws all text with the Kromvia font. Switch it off for the normal Minecraft font.

name: Kromvia Players
text: Shows the capes and cosmetics of other Kromvia players.

name: Light Level
text: Shows the block light level where you stand, handy for mob-proofing.

name: Looking At
text: Names the block or mob you are looking at.

name: Low Fire
text: Makes the fire overlay smaller so you can see.

name: Low HP Warning
text: Tints the screen red when your health gets low.

name: Lyrics
text: Shows synced lyrics for the song you are playing.

name: Memory
text: Shows how much RAM the game is using.

name: Motion Blur
text: Blurs the screen when you move the camera.

name: Movement Status
text: Shows if you are sprinting, sneaking, swimming, gliding or flying.

name: Music
text: Shows the song you are playing. Press M for the music menu.

name: Nametags
text: Restyles nametags, shows your own and can hide your nick.

name: Nearby Players
text: Lists the players near you and how far away they are.

name: Nether Coords
text: Shows where you would come out in the other dimension.

name: No Fog
text: Removes distance fog.

name: No Hurt Cam
text: Stops the screen shaking when you take damage.

name: No Pumpkin Blur
text: Removes the pumpkin overlay when you wear one.

name: Numeric Tab Ping
text: Shows ping as a number in the player list.

name: Overlays
text: Fire, shield, water, portal and spyglass overlays: lower, see-through or hidden.

name: Pack Display
text: Shows which resource packs are on.

name: Particles
text: Fewer particles, and hides block breaking or explosions if you want.

name: Party Pings
text: Press Z to mark the block you look at. Your party sees the mark on any server, except PvP servers where it is off.

name: Ping
text: Shows your latency to the server.

name: Player Count
text: Shows how many players are online.

name: Potion Effects
text: Lists your active potion effects with time left.

name: Reach Display
text: Shows the distance of your last hit.

name: Rotation
text: Shows your exact yaw and pitch.

name: Scoreboard
text: Restyles the sidebar scoreboard: size, position, background.

name: Screen Colours
text: Saturation, brightness, contrast and hue for the whole screen.

name: Server Address
text: Shows the address of the server you are playing on.

name: Server TPS
text: Estimates the server's ticks per second, so you can tell server lag from your own.

name: Session Time
text: Shows how long you have been playing this session.

name: Show Welcome Guide
text: Opens the first-launch guide again.

name: Snaplook (hold V)
text: Hold V to look at yourself from the front.

name: Sound Volumes
text: A volume slider for each kind of sound.

name: Speed
text: Shows how fast you are moving in blocks per second.

name: Stopwatch & Timer
text: A stopwatch that starts when you switch it on, or a countdown. Switch it off and on to restart.

name: Stretched 4:3
text: Stretches the game to a 4:3 look.

name: Target HUD
text: Shows the health and armour of whoever you are fighting.

name: Target Marker
text: Draws a marker over the player you are fighting.

name: Time Changer
text: Sets the time of day for you only.

name: Toggle Sneak
text: Press sneak once to stay sneaking.

name: Totem Pop Counter
text: Tells you when someone pops a Totem of Undying, and how many times.

name: Trails
text: Leaves a coloured trail behind you.

name: Vanilla HUD
text: Resizes or hides titles, the action bar and boss bars.

name: Visible Damage
text: Shows the damage of each hit as a number.

name: Weather
text: Controls rain, snow, lightning and the fishing line.

name: World Time
text: Shows the in-game time of day as a clock.

name: XP Level
text: Shows your level and how far you are to the next one.
